title: Construct Extraction Provider Identity
description: Identity and declared capabilities of a document extraction provider (construct-tsyfe.2.1). Extraction today is dispatched purely on file extension (lib/document-extract.mjs) and each backend (node-native, the docling sidecar, Docling Serve) returns a slightly different ad hoc shape. This schema is the registration surface a provider ladder can certify against: who the provider is, and what it promises before a single extraction call is made. What one call actually returns is schemas/extraction-result.schema.json. Net-new contract definition: no extractor is migrated to this schema here, no routing logic changes.

version.description: Provider or backing-library version string (e.g. docling package version).

configFingerprint.description: Stable summary/hash of the provider configuration that affects output determinism (model version, OCR settings, remote endpoint) so two runs can be compared for parity.

losslessWhereAvailable.description: Declared capability: whether this provider CAN preserve source structure losslessly when the source format supports it. The actual per-call outcome (and reason when not achieved) is reported on the extraction-result contract, not here.

supportsRichDocument.description: Whether this provider normalizes its output into RichDocument-shaped structure (ADR-0073, lib/rich-document.mjs) rather than flat text only.
